text:
derek: Staging alert — after latest RBAC refactor (viewer/editor/admin) I can still export API keys from Console as a viewer. Repro:
1) login as viewer
2) Org -> API keys
3) click '...' -> Export
Expected: button disabled/hidden. Actual: modal opens. :eyes:

samir: thanks. can you paste the trace id / request id from the browser console or network log? also is this only for API keys or other resources?

derek: trace=trace-9c3f; only saw it on API keys page so far. attaching quick network snippet:
```
POST /orgs/123/api_keys/export 200 OK
response: {"token": "redacted"}
headers: x-audit-id: null
```
No x-audit-id header.

andrea: pinging eng-frontend. most likely UI didn't gate by resource permission after role matrix rename. quick check: code in ui/src/components/KeyRow.tsx uses role === 'admin' instead of hasPermission('api_keys.export'). I'll open a PR to switch to permissions service.

maria: from audit perspective this is concerning — export should produce audit log and KMS envelope usage. If x-audit-id missing, our log pipeline won't pick it up. can infra check KMS usage for that request id?

ops-bot: Deployed frontend rev 2026.03.19-ff2 to staging at 2026-03-19T17:20:31Z :rocket:

samir: also check the server-side ACL enforcement. UI gating is one layer; server must reject unauthorized requests. who owns the api_keys export handler?

andrea: backend owner is kelly-keys (cc @kelly). @kelly can you verify server handler checks role/permission? current code had 'if (user.role !== "viewer")' which is inverted now after role rename.

kelly: looking. quick follow-up: our role matrix changed and a middle role got inserted during the refactor which broke assumptions. I'll roll a server patch to assert hasPermission('api_keys:export') and add audit header. ETA 2h.

derek: thanks. for mitigation can we temporarily disable export button for all non-admins until patch? frontend PR will land in 30m.

maria: filing a compliance ticket with compliance@redwood to document incident and evidence. including KMS key IDs and missing audit headers. tagging SOC.

samir: once patched, add an e2e asserting export endpoint returns 403 for viewer role. also add an integration test verifying x-audit-id present and KMS logging.

derek: noted. will monitor staging and report back. :lock:
